areas.title: Seed: Meter reading validation
areas.summary: Validate a new meter reading against the previous reading before billing. Rules for abnormal-high thresholds and estimated bills come from billing policy.

cases.title: Reject current reading lower than previous
steps: Open a QA- account with previous reading 1200
Enter current reading 1199
Save
cases.expected: Reading is rejected with a clear message unless meter replacement or rollover is selected

cases.title: Current reading equal to previous gives zero consumption
steps: Open a QA- account with previous reading 1200
Enter current reading 1200
Save
cases.expected: Reading is accepted with 0 m³ consumption; bill lines match the tariff oracle for zero consumption (minimum charge)

cases.title: Meter rollover reading
steps: Open a QA- account whose previous reading is near the meter maximum
Enter a small current reading and mark it as rollover
Save
cases.expected: Consumption is computed across the rollover; bill lines match the tariff oracle

cases.title: Abnormal-high consumption is flagged
steps: Open a QA- account with a known average consumption
Enter a reading just above the abnormal-high threshold
Save
cases.expected: Reading is flagged for review; a reading just below the threshold is not flagged (threshold: unknown, per policy)

cases.title: Missing reading produces an estimated bill per policy
steps: Leave a QA- account unread in the book
Run the bill run for its route
cases.expected: Account is billed as estimated per policy and marked estimated (policy: unknown)

areas.title: Seed: Tariff computation
areas.summary: Each customer class × each consumption tier boundary, minimum charge, fixed charges and approved discounts. Expected amounts always come from the tariff oracle and data/tariffs.

cases.title: Consumption exactly at each tier boundary, per customer class
steps: For each customer class and tier boundary, create a QA- reading at the boundary
Generate the bill
cases.expected: Bill lines match the tariff oracle

cases.title: Consumption one m³ below and above each tier boundary
steps: For each boundary, create QA- readings at boundary − 1 and boundary + 1
Generate the bills
cases.expected: Bill lines match the tariff oracle

cases.title: Minimum charge applies at low consumption
steps: Create a QA- reading inside the minimum-charge block
Generate the bill
cases.expected: Minimum charge applies; bill lines match the tariff oracle

cases.title: Tariff table drives the bill for every class
steps: Load the approved tariff data file
Generate one QA- bill per class and tier
cases.expected: Every bill matches the tariff oracle for the effective date

cases.title: Approved discount applied only to eligible accounts
steps: Create QA- accounts with and without the discount flag
Generate bills
cases.expected: Discount appears only on eligible accounts; amounts match the tariff oracle (eligibility rules: unknown)

areas.title: Seed: Bill run per zone/route
areas.summary: A bill run for a zone or route creates exactly one bill per active billable account, with totals equal to the sum of lines.

cases.title: Bill count equals active billable accounts
steps: Run the bill run for a QA- route
Count bills and active billable accounts on the route
cases.expected: Counts are equal (recon check)

cases.title: Re-running a bill run creates no duplicates
steps: Run the bill run for a QA- route
Run it again for the same period
cases.expected: Second run is refused or creates no duplicate bills (duplicate-bill recon check passes)

cases.title: Bill total equals the sum of its lines
steps: Run the bill run for a QA- route
Compare each bill total with the sum of its lines
cases.expected: Every total equals the sum of lines (recon check)

areas.title: Seed: Penalties
areas.summary: Penalties apply after the due date. Weekend and holiday handling and waiver approval follow policy.

cases.title: Payment on the due date has no penalty
steps: Pay a QA- bill on its due date
cases.expected: No penalty is applied

cases.title: Payment one day after the due date has a penalty
steps: Pay a QA- bill one day after its due date
cases.expected: Penalty is applied; amount matches the tariff oracle

cases.title: Due date on a weekend or holiday
steps: Create a QA- bill whose due date falls on a holiday
Pay on the next working day
cases.expected: Penalty follows the holiday policy (policy: unknown)

cases.title: Penalty waiver needs approval
steps: As a preparer, request a penalty waiver on a QA- bill
Try to apply it without approval
cases.expected: Waiver is not applied until an approver other than the preparer approves it

areas.title: Seed: Payments and ORs
areas.summary: Full, partial and advance payments, multiple bills, reversal with approval, duplicate prevention, and a unique, gap-free OR sequence per collector/series.

cases.title: Full payment clears the bill
steps: Pay the full balance of a QA- bill
Open the account ledger
cases.expected: Bill is paid, an OR is issued, and the balance matches the ledger oracle

cases.title: Partial payment leaves the correct balance
steps: Pay part of a QA- bill
cases.expected: Remaining balance matches the ledger oracle; an OR is issued

cases.title: Overpayment is held as advance
steps: Pay more than the balance of a QA- bill
cases.expected: Excess is recorded as an advance and applied to the next bill per policy

cases.title: Duplicate payment is prevented
steps: Submit the same QA- payment twice quickly
cases.expected: Only one payment and one OR are recorded

cases.title: Payment reversal needs approval
steps: As a collector, reverse a QA- payment
cases.expected: Reversal waits for approval by a different user; the original OR stays linked

cases.title: OR numbers are unique and gap-free per collector
steps: Post several QA- payments for one collector and series
Run the OR sequence recon check
cases.expected: No gaps or duplicates in the series

areas.title: Seed: Disconnection and reconnection
areas.summary: Disconnection and reconnection lifecycle states and fees.

cases.title: Disconnect, pay, reconnect
steps: Disconnect a QA- account with arrears
Pay the arrears and reconnection fee
Reconnect
cases.expected: Each state change is recorded; the fee matches the tariff oracle

cases.title: Reconnection refused while arrears remain
steps: Try to reconnect a disconnected QA- account with unpaid arrears
cases.expected: Reconnection is refused with a clear message

areas.title: Seed: Collection posting
areas.summary: Daily collection report = sum of ORs = cash/bank deposit = GL cash and AR entries.

cases.title: Daily collection report equals the sum of ORs
steps: Post QA- payments for a day
Generate the daily collection report
cases.expected: Report total = sum of ORs (recon check)

cases.title: Collections post balanced GL cash and AR entries
steps: Post the day's QA- collections to the GL
cases.expected: Cash and AR entries balance and equal the report total (ledger oracle)

areas.title: Seed: BAM and debit/credit memos
areas.summary: BAMs and debit/credit memos go through validation, approval and posting. Balances change only at posting, and the approver must differ from the preparer.

cases.title: Balance unchanged until the memo is posted
steps: Prepare a QA- credit memo
Validate and approve it
Check the account balance
Post it
cases.expected: Balance changes only after posting; the change matches the ledger oracle

cases.title: Preparer cannot approve their own memo
steps: Prepare a QA- BAM
Try to approve it as the same user
cases.expected: Approval is refused

cases.title: Posting an unapproved memo is refused
steps: Call the post endpoint for a validated but unapproved QA- memo
cases.expected: Request is rejected; no balance change

cases.title: Each memo stage writes an audit entry
steps: Take a QA- debit memo through prepare, validate, approve and post
Open the audit trail
cases.expected: Each stage shows who, when, and before → after

areas.title: Seed: Meter-reading book workflow
areas.summary: Book states To Do → For Download → Downloaded → In Progress → Complete → For Review → Verified. Reader records are NotUploaded, Read, Unreadable, Missed or NotRequired. Upload completion compares the phone manifest with stored records in one transaction.

cases.title: Book moves through every state in order
steps: Schedule a QA- book
Download it as the assigned reader
Upload readings
Review and verify as supervisor
cases.expected: Book passes To Do → For Download → Downloaded → In Progress → Complete → For Review → Verified

cases.title: Reader cannot download another reader's book
steps: As reader A, request the download of a book assigned to reader B
cases.expected: Request is refused

cases.title: Reader login refused outside the allowed office network
steps: Authenticate as a QA- reader from a network outside the allowlist
cases.expected: Login is refused

cases.title: Upload with a manifest mismatch is rolled back
steps: Upload a QA- book whose manifest lists more records than were sent
cases.expected: Upload is not completed and no partial records are saved

cases.title: Supervisor correction needs a reason
steps: Edit a reading during review without a reason
cases.expected: Edit is refused; with a reason, an edit record is stored separately from the original

cases.title: Admin and phone status writes don't conflict
steps: Change a QA- book's status from admin while the phone sends a status update
cases.expected: One write wins by the conditional update; the book is never left in an invalid state

areas.title: Seed: JMS process sequence
areas.summary: Each JMS code defines an ordered process sequence. The sequence gate blocks creating or completing a later process while prerequisite work is open.

cases.title: Later process blocked while a prerequisite is open
steps: Create a QA- JMS whose sequence requires an OP before the MCR
Try to create the MCR before the OP is paid
cases.expected: Request is refused by the sequence gate

cases.title: Paid OP releases the next automatic process
steps: Pay the OP of a QA- JMS
Wait for the paid-order sweep (every 2 minutes)
cases.expected: JMS records the payment and the next eligible automatic process starts

cases.title: Voided JMS accepts no further work
steps: Void a QA- JMS
Try to add a maintenance order to it
cases.expected: Request is refused

cases.title: Completing a JMS updates the CRM ticket
steps: Complete every process of a QA- JMS created from a CRM ticket
cases.expected: Job is Completed, the customer is notified and the CRM ticket is updated

areas.title: Seed: MCR change control
areas.summary: MCR states Draft → Submitted → Returned/Validated → Approved → Posted, or Void. Approval does not change the customer record; posting re-runs readiness checks and applies the change, and a failed post leaves no partial update.

cases.title: Approval does not change the customer record
steps: Take a QA- MCR to Approved
Open the customer record
cases.expected: Record is unchanged until the MCR is posted

cases.title: Post re-runs readiness checks
steps: Approve a QA- MCR
Make a readiness condition false (e.g. reverse the payment)
Post the MCR
cases.expected: Post is refused, the MCR returns to an actionable state, and the customer record is unchanged

cases.title: Returned MCR can be resubmitted
steps: Return a submitted QA- MCR
Edit and resubmit it
cases.expected: MCR goes Returned → Submitted with history

cases.title: Posting skipping approval is refused
steps: Call the post endpoint for a Validated QA- MCR
cases.expected: Request is rejected

cases.title: Voided MCR cannot be posted
steps: Void a QA- MCR
Call the post endpoint
cases.expected: Request is rejected

areas.title: Seed: NSC application lifecycle
areas.summary: NSC statuses PreVerified, Submitted, ForRequirementsVerification, Investigation, WaiverPending, PaymentVerification, ContractSigning, InstallationPending, Completed, Cancelled, Disqualified, Archived, PendingReinvestigation. Every valid transition writes a status-history record. Files: PDF/JPG/JPEG/PNG/HEIC, 10 MB each, 60 MB per submission.

cases.title: Happy path writes status history at every step
steps: Submit a QA- NSC application
Take it through verification, investigation, payment, contract and installation
cases.expected: Reaches Completed; each transition has one status-history record

cases.title: Skipping a status is refused
steps: Move a QA- application from Investigation straight to InstallationPending
cases.expected: Transition is rejected and no history record is written

cases.title: Requirement file exactly 10 MB is accepted, 10 MB + 1 byte refused
steps: Upload a 10 MB PDF
Upload a 10 MB + 1 byte PDF
cases.expected: First is accepted, second refused with a size message

cases.title: Submission total above 60 MB is refused
steps: Upload requirement files totalling just over 60 MB
cases.expected: Submission is refused with a size message

cases.title: Disallowed file type is refused
steps: Upload a .exe renamed to .pdf, and a .gif
cases.expected: Both are refused

cases.title: Staff-only NSC actions are enforced on the server
steps: As a customer-portal user, call a staff NSC endpoint (e.g. verify requirements) directly
cases.expected: Request is refused with 403, not just hidden in the UI

cases.title: Concurrent edits are detected
steps: Open the same QA- application as two users
Save both
cases.expected: Second save is rejected as a version conflict

cases.title: BCS reconciliation sets the account number
steps: Complete installation of a QA- application
Wait for the BCS export and reconciliation
cases.expected: Application has the account number returned by BCS

areas.title: Seed: Order of Payment
areas.summary: OP creation validates amount, type/COA, customer and any JMS prerequisite, generates a reference number and starts as Pending. The paid-order sweep runs every 2 minutes.

cases.title: New OP gets a reference number and Pending status
steps: Create a valid QA- OP
cases.expected: OP has a unique reference number and status Pending

cases.title: OP with zero or negative amount is refused
steps: Create a QA- OP with amount 0.00
Create one with amount -0.01
Create one with amount 0.01
cases.expected: 0.00 and -0.01 are refused; 0.01 is accepted

cases.title: OP with an inactive COA is refused
steps: Create a QA- OP using an inactive COA
cases.expected: Request is refused

cases.title: Paid OP cannot be paid again
steps: Pay a QA- OP
Try to pay it again
cases.expected: Second payment is refused

areas.title: Seed: Purchase request to PO
areas.summary: Purchase request approval chain by amount threshold, with a budget check before the PO is issued. Thresholds follow the procurement office's rules.

cases.title: Approval chain by amount threshold
steps: Create QA- PRs just below, at and just above each threshold
cases.expected: Each PR routes to the approvers the threshold table requires (thresholds: unknown)

cases.title: PO blocked when budget is insufficient
steps: Approve a QA- PR larger than the remaining budget
Try to issue the PO
cases.expected: PO is not issued; message names the budget shortfall

areas.title: Seed: Receiving and 3-way match
areas.summary: Partial receiving, over-receiving blocked, inspection and returns. Payment only after a PO × receipt × invoice match within tolerance and approval.

cases.title: Partial receipt keeps the PO open
steps: Receive part of a QA- PO
cases.expected: PO shows the remaining quantity and stays open

cases.title: Over-receiving is blocked
steps: Receive the ordered quantity + 1 on a QA- PO
cases.expected: Receipt is refused

cases.title: Invoice outside tolerance blocks payment
steps: Record a QA- invoice just outside the match tolerance
Try to prepare the DV
cases.expected: DV is blocked until the mismatch is resolved (tolerance: unknown)

areas.title: Seed: Inventory movements
areas.summary: Stock in/out, no negative stock, valuation checked against the inventory oracle, reorder alerts and issuance to job orders.

cases.title: Issuing more than on hand is refused
steps: Issue on-hand quantity + 1 of a QA- item
cases.expected: Issuance is refused; stock never goes negative

cases.title: Valuation after a sequence of movements
steps: Post a series of QA- receipts and issues
cases.expected: Quantity and valuation match the inventory oracle

cases.title: Reorder alert at the reorder point
steps: Issue a QA- item down to exactly its reorder point
cases.expected: A reorder alert is raised; one unit above, no alert

areas.title: Seed: Postings and period close
areas.summary: Every posting balances to the centavo, subledgers equal their GL control accounts, closed periods reject postings, and reversals link to originals.

cases.title: Unbalanced journal is refused
steps: Post a QA- journal whose debits differ from credits by 0.01
cases.expected: Posting is refused

cases.title: Posting into a closed period is refused
steps: Close a period
Post a QA- journal dated inside it
cases.expected: Posting is refused

cases.title: Subledgers equal GL control accounts
steps: Run the subledger = GL recon checks for AR, AP, inventory and payroll payable
cases.expected: All checks pass

cases.title: Reversing entry links to the original
steps: Reverse a QA- journal
cases.expected: Reversal is linked to the original and nets it to zero

areas.title: Seed: Financial reports
areas.summary: Trial balance and financial statements tie to the GL; exports match on-screen totals; inactive accounts are blocked from new entries.

cases.title: Trial balance ties to the GL
steps: Generate the trial balance for a period
cases.expected: Totals equal the GL and debits = credits (recon check)

cases.title: PDF and XLSX exports match on-screen totals
steps: Export a report to PDF and XLSX
Compare totals with the screen
cases.expected: All three match; names with ñ render correctly

cases.title: Inactive account blocked from new entries
steps: Post a QA- journal to an inactive account
cases.expected: Posting is refused

areas.title: Seed: Attendance and leave
areas.summary: Attendance becomes payable days and hours; leave balances accrue and over-use is blocked.

cases.title: Leave request equal to the balance is accepted
steps: File QA- leave for exactly the remaining balance
cases.expected: Request is accepted and the balance becomes 0

cases.title: Leave request above the balance is refused
steps: File QA- leave for balance + 1 day
cases.expected: Request is refused

cases.title: Attendance converts to payable days and hours
steps: Load a QA- attendance set with late, undertime and absence entries
cases.expected: Payable days and hours match the payroll oracle

areas.title: Seed: Payroll
areas.summary: Gross-to-net checked against the payroll oracle with contribution and tax tables kept as data files; approval workflow; payslip privacy; balanced GL entries.

cases.title: Gross-to-net matches the payroll oracle
steps: Run payroll for QA- employees across salary brackets
cases.expected: Gross, each deduction and net match the payroll oracle

cases.title: Employee sees only their own payslip
steps: As QA- employee A, request employee B's payslip by ID
cases.expected: Request is refused with 403 or 404

cases.title: Payroll preparer cannot approve
steps: Prepare a QA- payroll
Try to approve it as the same user
cases.expected: Approval is refused

cases.title: Payroll posts balanced GL entries
steps: Approve and post a QA- payroll
cases.expected: GL entries balance and match the ledger oracle

areas.title: Seed: Cross-cutting controls
areas.summary: RBAC matrix through UI and API, segregation of duties, audit trail, concurrency, and data edge cases (rounding, negative and very large amounts, Filipino names with ñ, date and period boundaries, session timeout).

cases.title: Denied action is refused through the API, not just hidden
steps: For each role, call every action it may not perform directly through the API
cases.expected: Each call is refused with 403

cases.title: Every financial change has an audit entry
steps: Make a QA- financial change
Open the audit trail
cases.expected: Entry shows who, when, and before → after

cases.title: Two users paying the same bill at once
steps: Submit payments for the same QA- bill from two sessions at the same time
cases.expected: Only one succeeds or both are applied correctly; balance matches the ledger oracle

cases.title: Names with ñ and accents save and print correctly
steps: Create a QA- customer named "QA-Peña, José Niño"
View, search and print it
cases.expected: Name is stored, found and printed exactly

cases.title: Very large and negative amounts are handled
steps: Submit amounts at the field maximum, maximum + 0.01, and -0.01
cases.expected: Maximum is accepted; the others are refused with clear messages

cases.title: Session timeout protects unsaved work
steps: Leave a form idle past the session timeout
Submit
cases.expected: User is asked to sign in again; no partial record is saved
